thread:
Lina (Finance): Heads-up: NordicaTech (regional reseller) asked for a pilot-specific concession: 15% floor credit on usage + net60 payment terms. Pilot is 4 months. Need deal-desk review + CFO signoff for extended terms.

Marc (Sales): They handle eldercare customers in SE. Pilot projection ~80k tokens/mo ramping to 350k. They want Redwood to show flexibility to win the first 3 hospital contracts.

Priya (RevOps): Operational asks: (a) cap total credits to EUR 12k, (b) restrict credits to reseller account ID only, (c) need clawback if end-customer cancels within 60 days. Also specify invoicing flow for VAT (reseller to submit VAT ID).

Jonah (Legal): Can do an addendum. Need definition: "floor credit" = percentage applied to billed usage before discounts, and explicit end date for the pilot. Will add disclosure around tax reps and audit rights.

Arjun (CFO): Net60 increases DSO. I'll approve only if AR risk is mitigated: propose 40% of credits escrowed (held on ledger) and require reseller credit check + trade ref. Also want FX exposure note: invoice in EUR or USD?

Marc (Sales): Nordica submitted VAT ID and trade ref doc (attached to ticket). Prefer invoices in EUR to match their collections.

Lina (Finance): EUR invoices ok. We need accounting entry guidance: record credit as deferred contra-revenue and release monthly. Priya, can Zuora handle the holdback and deferred ledger?

Priya (RevOps): Yes — Zuora payment term = Net60; create a custom charge type for "pilot credit" and set recognition rule. I'll open a billing config ticket: ZOA-7891. We'll also add AR collection workflow for payments past 30 days.

Jonah (Legal): Draft addendum ready; sending to Marc for signature routing. Key points: 15% floor credit up to EUR 3k/mo cap, pilot start 2026-08-01, clawback within 60 days prorated, reseller reps on VAT.

Marc (Sales): Sending addendum to Nordica now. ETA 24h.

billing-bot: Created accounting ticket ZOA-7891 and AR holdback rule. Linked to deal ND-77.

Arjun (CFO): Conditional approval granted. Final approval once: (1) signed addendum, (2) proof of VAT ID + trade refs on file, (3) ZOA-7891 implemented with 40% holdback escrow.

Lina (Finance): Approved in principle. Final sign-off will be me after AR control confirmation. Tagging this for monthly approval tracker.

Marc (Sales): Thanks team. I'll post signer confirmation here when received. :pray:
